subject: Telemetry compatibility sandbox: proposal & access
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Grant <alex.grant@signalworks.com>, SignalWorks Integrations <integrations@signalworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry compatibility sandbox: proposal & access

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, we'd like to stand up a short-lived compatibility sandbox so your integrations team can validate the OTLP path and Datadog agent translation for the next two weeks. The sandbox will mirror the production routing logic for prefix/KV caching and include a lightweight Grafana instance for downstream dashboard checks.

High-level proposal: 
- Duration: 14 days (can extend with a quick follow-up)
- Scope: OTLP collector -> Redwood OTLP relay -> Datadog agent / Grafana HTTTP ingest
- Tests we want to run: metric and span fidelity (sampling parity), trace context propagation, tag/labels mapping, and service name collisions
- Deliverables: access instructions, a compatibility matrix to capture pass/fail items, and automated smoke tests we can run nightly

I've attached sandbox-access-instructions.pdf and a starting compatibility-matrix.xlsx. Can you confirm:
1) Which SignalWorks engineers will participate?
2) Any required hostnames / IP allowlists we should include up front?
3) Are there retention or S3 endpoint constraints we need to model?

Proposed kick-off: Friday 2027-05-21 09:00 PT (30 min). If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to moving fast on this.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: sandbox-access-instructions.pdf (PDF, 85 KB)]
[Attachment: compatibility-matrix.xlsx (Excel, 45 KB)]

From: Alex Grant <alex.grant@signalworks.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: SignalWorks Integrations <integrations@signalworks.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry compatibility sandbox: proposal & access

Thanks Jasmine — this looks good. Quick answers:
- Joining engineers: myself (Alex), Priya Shah (priyaa@signalworks.com), and Marco Ruiz (marco.ruiz@signalworks.com).
- Allowlist: we'll need the relay DNS name and a small set of egress IPs; can you provide a CIDR or concrete hostnames?
- Retention: for the sandbox we prefer short retention (24-72h) but we need to validate our S3-compatible object store endpoints (we use MinIO in our CI).

One ask: can the compatibility matrix include a column for "expected behavioral delta" so the docs team can decide whether to file a downstream compatibility note?

We'll plan to join a Fri 9am PT kickoff. Also — is there a lightweight NDA or sandbox terms we need to sign before access?

Alex
Alex Grant
Head of Integrations, SignalWorks
alex.grant@signalworks.com | +1 (212) 555-0178

Agree with all of the above. A couple of notes from our side: 
- We can provide a short CIDR block for the relay egress (will share once infra allocates) — for the sandbox we'll also support DNS-based allowlist if you prefer hostnames.
- MinIO endpoint testing is fine; we'll spin up a temp bucket and lifecycle rule so objects expire after 48 hours.
- Matrix: yes — add columns: severity, expected delta, owner (Redwood/SignalWorks), and test harness link.

I'll take point on the onboarding runbook and smoke-test harness (we'll run it nightly across the 14d window). Laura, I think you can own the docs templates / matrix columns?

Ben Carter
Head of Field Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0099

[Attachment: smoke-test-harness-readme.md (text, 4 KB)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Grant <alex.grant@signalworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:04:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry compatibility sandbox: proposal & access

Alex — thanks for the quick responses and team details. A few final items before we flip the sandbox live: 

1) Terms & access: we have a short sandbox NDA (DocuSign link below). Please sign so we can provision accounts.
2) Allowlist & endpoints: our infra team will publish a short CIDR + relay DNS by EOD today. Expect: relay-us-west-2.redwood-inference.internal (will provide cert pin).
3) Retention: we'll enable a 48-hour lifecycle for objects in the temp bucket — that should cover MinIO validation.
4) Matrix & tests: Laura will share the first matrix revision Monday morning; Ben will post the nightly harness link to the shared drive.

Action items:
- Alex: sign sandbox NDA (https://www.docusign.com/sandbox-nda/SW-2027-0013) and confirm final list of engineers (Priya/Marco ok).
- Ben: publish CIDR and smoke-test harness link to the shared drive.
- Laura: seed the matrix with the columns we discussed and add an initial set of 10 checks.

Tentative kickoff: Fri 2027-05-21 09:00 PT — I'll still send the calendar invite but if we need to move it to Monday that's fine.

Thanks everyone — excited to get this running.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
